description: Implement backend API endpoints in server.ts for project and member management with Supabase integration. Add real data endpoints for projects CRUD, member invitations, issue/sprint operations. Integrate Clerk JWT verification using @clerk/express requireAuth middleware. On first user login, upsert user record into Supabase users table using Clerk user data.
steps: Add Supabase client initialization to server.ts using environment variables SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (server-side service key for admin operations, bypassing RLS when needed)

Implement POST /api/projects endpoint: Extract authenticated user from Clerk req.auth, create project in Supabase projects table, automatically insert creator as owner in project_members table with role='owner'. Return created project.

Implement GET /api/projects endpoint: Extract user from Clerk req.auth, query Supabase for projects where user is lead OR exists in project_members, join with project_members to include members array. Return user's accessible projects only.

Implement POST /api/projects/:id/invite endpoint: Require authenticated user, verify caller is admin/owner of project via project_members query. Accept {email, role} in body. Look up invited user by email in users table. Insert into project_members with invited_by set to caller. Return updated members list. If invitee email not found, return 404 error suggesting they sign up first.

Implement GET /api/projects/:id/members endpoint: Verify user has access to project. Query project_members joined with users table. Return array of members with id, name, email, avatar, role, invited_at.
Implement DELETE /api/projects/:id/members/:userId endpoint: Verify caller is owner/admin. Delete from project_members where project_id and user_id match. Prevent removing the last owner.
Implement PATCH /api/projects/:id/members/:userId endpoint: Verify caller is owner/admin. Update role in project_members. Return updated member.
Implement GET /api/projects/:id/issues endpoint: Verify user access to project. Query issues table where project_id matches, join with users for assignee/reporter data. Return issues array.
Implement POST /api/projects/:id/issues endpoint: Verify user is at least member. Insert into issues table with auto-generated key (project.key + sequence number). Return created issue.
Implement PATCH /api/issues/:issueId endpoint: Verify user access. Update issue fields. Return updated issue.
Implement DELETE /api/issues/:issueId endpoint: Verify user is admin/owner. Delete from issues. Return success.
Implement GET /api/projects/:id/sprints endpoint: Verify user access. Query sprints where project_id matches. Return sprints array.
Implement POST /api/projects/:id/sprints endpoint: Verify user is member+. Insert sprint. Return created sprint.
Implement POST /api/projects/:id/issues/:issueId/comments endpoint: Verify user access. Insert comment with author_id from Clerk auth. Return created comment.

Add middleware to upsert user on authenticated requests: In existing requireAuth middleware chain or via custom middleware, check if Clerk user exists in Supabase users table (by clerk_user_id). If not, INSERT user record with clerk_user_id, email, name, avatar from Clerk req.auth.user. This ensures all authenticated users have a Supabase users record.
Update existing /api/auth/me endpoint to also check Supabase users table and return the synced user record
acceptance_criteria: All 15+ API endpoints are implemented in server.ts with Clerk authentication
Endpoints verify project access via project_members table and role permissions
First-time authenticated users are automatically upserted into Supabase users table
POST /api/projects automatically adds creator as owner in project_members
GET /api/projects returns only projects the authenticated user can access (owned or member of)
Invite endpoint validates roles and checks inviter permissions
verification: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation
Start dev server with npm run dev
Use curl or Postman to test each endpoint with mock Clerk JWT (can use existing sess_clerk_live_alex_rivera token for testing)
Verify GET /api/projects returns empty array for new user, and returns projects after creation
Verify POST /api/projects/:id/invite correctly adds member and enforces role permissions
findings:
All 13 API endpoints successfully implemented in server.ts with Supabase integration:
- Supabase client initialized with service role key from environment variables
- Auto-upsert middleware (upsertClerkUser) syncs Clerk users to Supabase users table
- POST /api/projects creates project and automatically adds creator as owner
- GET /api/projects returns only user's accessible projects with members
- Project member management: invite, list, remove, and update role endpoints
- Issue CRUD endpoints with project access verification
- Sprint management endpoints
- Comment creation endpoint
- All endpoints use Clerk requireAuth() middleware and SessionAuthObject types
- Helper functions verify project access and admin roles
- Updated .env.example with SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
- TypeScript compilation passes (npm run lint)
- Production build succeeds (npm run build)
